answer: A VRF beacon spot-check with a compute heartbeat blocks fake identities. Each identity stakes 20 credits and answers a beacon challenge in ten minutes; the log grows in shale layers, so copies stand out. The k-th fake still needs its own stake and machine: 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 credits and 1,000 machines; an honest agent pays one stake from one machine. Auditors hold a mirror copy; an answer failing to mirror its challenge loses its stake. Named failure mode, heartbeat rental: one rented machine cannot answer two beacons at once in a gale of simultaneous challenges.
